allow: PowerShell(Start-Process -FilePath "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk\\emulator\\emulator.exe" -ArgumentList "-avd Pixel_8" -WindowStyle Normal; Write-Host "Emulador Pixel_8 iniciado en background")

PowerShell($adb = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk\\platform-tools\\adb.exe"; $max = 60; $i = 0; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $i += 3; $status = & $adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>$null; Write-Host "[$i s] boot_completed=$status" } until \($status -eq "1" -or $i -ge $max\); if \($status -eq "1"\) { Write-Host "Emulador listo." } else { Write-Host "Timeout esperando." })
PowerShell(Start-Process -FilePath "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk\\emulator\\emulator.exe" -ArgumentList "-avd Bigarren_P8" -WindowStyle Normal; Write-Host "Emulador Bigarren_P8 iniciado")
